**The meaning of the verse**
﴿وَآتِ ذَا الْقُرْبَىٰ حَقَّهُ وَالْمِسْكِينَ وَابْنَ السَّبِيلِ وَلَا تُبَذِّرْ تَبْذِيرًا﴾
Be good to everyone related to you, and give them their right of kindness and good treatment; and give to the poor person who does not have what is enough for him and meets his need, and to the traveller cut off from his family and his money. And do not spend your money in anything other than obeying Allah, or wastefully and extravagantly.

📖 At-Tafsir Al-Muyassar — King Fahd Complex.

**Talk with your child**
1. Why did Khalid drink from the jar when his bottle was full? And was that forbidden? (Sharif said it was not haram, but the Hajj had put it there for those who had no water; good manners are leaving what was put out for those in need to them.)
2. What happened when Uncle Rizq reached the jar? And why did Khalid's face turn red?
3. How did Khalid and his two friends put things right? And who is the "wayfarer" that the verse mentions?

**This week's exercise**
When your child goes out this week, they carry an extra bottle of water and give it to a worker, a guard or a cleaner in the heat. Or put some cold water by the door with you for whoever passes by.
